name: Mass
owner: InRetail Perú Corp. (Intercorp group) — Food Retail unit (Supermercados Peruanos)

logoSources.notes: 'Mass' + check wordmark: vector geometry from Wikimedia Commons (Wikidata P154), verified identical in shape to the current site logo https://www.tiendasmass.com.pe/wp-content/themes/mass/img/mass_logo.webp (160x37, too small to use directly), recoloured from the Commons navy #2D3F87 to the site logo's blue #0A2DB7, centred on the yellow #FDC616 of the official favicon https://www.tiendasmass.com.pe/wp-content/themes/mass/img/favicon.png (yellow square + blue check). Badge re-composed 2026-10-01 (data polish) so it reads at 32 px: the badge keeps only the letters 'Mass' (with the check they were ~4 px tall at 32 px); logos/mass-wide.png keeps the check.
Same recoloured wordmark (#0A2DB7), transparent, trimmed, 512 px wide.

notes: Hard-discount proximity format of InRetail. Off by default (defaultOn false since 2026-10-01): a ~1,600-store proximity format like Tambo and Oxxo, absent from the user's reference slides, whose markers swamp a map; users switch it on per map. Store count: InRetail Q2'26 earnings presentation, Food Retail 'Hard Discount' = 1,602 stores at 30 Jun 2026 (Mass is InRetail's hard-discount format: the 2025 Sustainability Report says Mass reached 1,550 locations after 300 openings in 2025, matching the Q4'25 Hard Discount figure). Colour: yellow #FDC616 (store signage/favicon) with a Mass-blue ring #0A2DB7 — keeps it apart from Metro (lemon yellow, gold ring) and Makro (blue badge, yellow text). OSM (probe 2026-10-01): only ~157 objects match (shop=supermarket/convenience/yes/general; 9 carry brand:wikidata=Q104814825, NSI tags Mass as shop=convenience) — OSM covers about a tenth of the 1,602 stores, so the web locator will matter. Tagging is inconsistent (shop=yes 'Mass', 'Tienda Mass', 'Tiendas Mass' shop=general), hence the wider shop list. The start-anchored regex rejects 'Massimo', 'Massage', 'Farmass', 'Lava Mass', 'Matimass', 'Mass Chicken Shop', and independents such as 'Supermercado MASS'/'Supermarket Mass' (operator 'Privado') and 'Mini Market Mass'. Still ambiguous and worth a manual look: 'Mass Ahorro', 'Mass Extra' (shop=convenience/supermarket).
